text:
maria: opened a focused PR to consolidate troubleshooting for 429s, timeouts, and context-trim behavior. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1580 :wave; goal is a short cross-refable guide for support and SDK teams.
kevin: nice. please call out Dedicated burst buckets vs Hosted rate-limits and how they appear during brief spikes. one sentence is fine.
sam: add Retry-After parsing examples (js + py). emphasize jitter and handling fractional seconds.
alex: for SDK consumers add a one-line link to the SDK helper; include raw-HTTP snippet for people using fetch/requests.
lisa: reminder: infra can retry on a compatible model variant which may return 200 with a warning or fewer tokens. include a short mapping of visible outcomes so devs don't misinterpret success.
maria: added a tiny mapping table and two short snippets. mapping: rate limit -> 429; runtime abort -> 504; context-trim -> 200 w/ "context_trimmed": true in payload.
docs-bot: checklist — PR 1580: linkcheck, snippet lint, SDK cross-ref. assigned to @kevin for review. :white_check_mark:
sam: nit: under "when to back off" add a one-line flow: spike -> short retries + jitter; sustained -> exponential backoff + alert.
alex: i'll draft the 2-line SDK-friendly wording to match retry helpers.
maria: added runbook link for "intermittent 429s without console quota spike" and a small combined example (backoff + reduce batch size). planning to merge after kevin+alex quick pass. pinging @support to surface to PMs if customers ask.
support: thanks — we'll watch tickets and flag recurring confusion.
maria: merging in ~30m if no objections. :rocket:
